bands.title: Most enterprises are drowning in data but starving for decisions
bands.lead: Dashboards multiply, reports pile up, and the finance team still exports to Excel every Monday morning. The problem is not a shortage of data — it is an excess of noise, a deficit of trust, and analytics tools that serve the data team but not the decision-maker. Ignitho cuts through. We build analytics that leaders actually open, forecasts they trust, and insight workflows that run themselves
